# The two microGPT programs on the compile path

The measuring stick of the compile-path work: `explorations/run-c4/src` (the flat
Run C4 model) and `explorations/apl/mg` (the APL-notation port). Every component and
api of both, pushed through `fortress compile` in dependency order, in the same
private cache as the ladder, immediately after the ladder run of this directory.

`phase` is decided by `classify.py`, the ladder's own classifier, so these rows are
the same kind of claim as a row of `ladder.tsv`. Only `fortress compile` was run;
nothing was linked or run, so `pass` here means the component compiled, not that it
produced an answer.

Per file: `fortress compile <file>` from the file's own directory, 300 s timeout.
